edits.old: Then the step routes the proposal to that approver and reads the approval answer, and this service holds no limit of its own
edits.new:
Then the step routes the proposal to that approver and reads the approval answer, and this service holds no limit of its own

  Scenario: AC12 An activity that is retried or times out does not change the stage twice (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the activity of the settlement step is retried or times out for case RC-2026-000713
    When the step runs again
    Then the stage and the case move are written once, and the decision record is written once with the rule version

  Scenario: AC13 A consumed call that fails or does not answer changes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed contract fails or does not answer for case RC-2026-000713
    When the step calls it
    Then nothing is written, the stage keeps its state and the step waits on the workflow's own schedule

  Scenario: AC14 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the case is in a state that the rule does not allow for the settlement step
    When the step is taken
    Then the system answers 409, nothing changes and no decision record is written

  Scenario: AC15 Error answers 401, 403 and 404 come from the provided operations (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a request to the provided operations carries no valid credential, a role without the right, or an action that does not exist or is out of scope
    When the request is answered
    Then the system answers 401, 403 or 404 as the case requires, and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC16 A replay of a write with the same idempotency key writes once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write arrives with an idempotency key that a previous write already used
    When the write is replayed
    Then the earlier result is returned, nothing is written again and the repeat is counted
